recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-27142 unless a future work group decision changes SubscriptionTopic URL or derivation rules.
issue_request: FHIR-27142 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 change request asking that SubscriptionTopic.url explain how to populate the canonical URL for locally defined or derived topics, when to also populate derivedFromCanonical, and when a direct implementation should reuse the registered or IG-defined topic URL.
initial_application: Commit f1a7871e3a61518dc91d9034ca8310491d61b90c, 'FHIR-27142 - Clarifications on canonical URL', added the requested SubscriptionTopic.url comment text to source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml. Later canonical-resource and pattern-alignment commits retained the same semantics.
additional_context: SubscriptionTopic is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-I minutes for 2020-05-18 record the FHIR-27142 Persuasive 10-0-0 motion, while nearby Subscription-track issues FHIR-27138 and FHIR-27141 cover separate canonical/search/cardinality decisions and do not supersede this clarification. Zulip searches found only issue logging and agenda mentions, with no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative StructureDefinition comment for SubscriptionTopic.url already covers all three requested cases, including use of derivedFromCanonical for derived topics and reuse of the IG/registered URL for direct implementations.
